judgments.fact: Eight repeated quaver chords have 4+4 beaming; tenuto occurs at attacks 1, 4, 7 while an independent slower melodic line continues.
judgments.reading_benefit: Half-bar counting, local touch pattern and sustained melody can remain separate visible layers.
judgments.alternative_cost: Rebeaming to every articulation location repeats one layer while weakening the existing metre reference.
judgments.boundary: Tenuto placement does not prove a unique stress, duration or velocity interpretation.

judgments.fact: Explicit Ped./release groups precede simile; explicit pedal groups return near changed accompaniment and ties, and another pattern is established before later simile.
judgments.reading_benefit: Reduces repeated instructions after a recognizable model while refreshing the model where the material changes.
judgments.alternative_cost: Global removal or indefinite propagation of simile erases local changes; independent excerpting may justify a reminder.
judgments.boundary: Pedal meaning inferred from placement and preceding groups; no internal scope, exact physical foot timing or playback inferred.

judgments.location: p3 final system into p4 first two systems
judgments.fact: A slower line transfers into the upper staff under high fast figuration; p4 keeps both layers with ledger lines, ties and local hand brackets.
judgments.reading_benefit: Maintains the simultaneous pitch relationships and the traceable slower line.
judgments.alternative_cost: Adding upper-voice-only 8va without explicit scope would create the at-pitch/transposed ambiguity; separate staff uses vertical and page budget.
judgments.boundary: No editable score or complete independent sounding-pitch verification; publisher intent unproven.

judgments.decision: retain pending a concrete beam-routing improvement
judgments.fact: The descending group crosses to the lower staff while its beam remains continuously above, creating long stems for the low notes.
judgments.reading_benefit: Keeps the descending group and its boundary visually traceable.
judgments.alternative_cost: A fixed ordinary stem length would require rerouting or dividing the beam and reconsidering the sustained chord and curves nearby.
judgments.boundary: Full clearance/minimum-stem geometry and a rerouted native candidate have not been tested; a long stem is not by itself an error.

judgments.fact: System measure counts are 3, 3, 8, 8, 3 under unchanged C metre; long cross-staff stems and double-line strokes have not been counted as extra measures.
judgments.reading_benefit: Fast figuration and interacting layers receive horizontal space; long harmonic spans do not waste a whole system per four sparse bars.
judgments.alternative_cost: Fixed four-measure lines could overexpand sparse material and remove vertical budget from dense runs.
judgments.boundary: No replacement rendering; no claim of uniquely optimal page count or measured improvement.
